blocks.text: When the numbers of moles of reactants and products in the balanced equation are equal, the units cancel and the equilibrium constant has no units: ester formation in solution, CH3COOH + C2H5OH giving CH3COOC2H5 + H2O, has Kc = (mol dm-3 x mol dm-3) / (mol dm-3 x mol dm-3), no units. When the mole numbers are unequal the value of the constant depends on the units used; in the Haber synthesis N2(g) + 3H2(g) giving 2NH3(g), Kc = [NH3]^2 / ([N2][H2]^3) has units (mol dm-3)^2 / (mol dm-3)^4 = 1 / (mol dm-3)^2 = mol-2 dm6.

blocks.prompt: For which of these does Kc have units of (concentration)^-1: N2 + 3H2 giving 2NH3; H2 + I2 giving 2HI; 2NO2 giving N2O4; 2HF giving H2 + F2?
blocks.explanation: 2NO2 giving N2O4: Kc = [N2O4] / [NO2]^2 has units mol dm-3 / (mol dm-3)^2 = (mol dm-3)^-1. Ammonia synthesis gives (concentration)^-2, and the other two, with equal moles on both sides, have no units.

items: Equal moles on both sides: Kc has no units (ester formation). Unequal moles: units remain (ammonia synthesis, mol-2 dm6), so the value depends on the units chosen.
